changes: New Penalty grass sprites setting in Graphics, to turn the grass tufts on Better Editor penalty grass on or off
Low End Device and Low performance mode turn them off, High End and Ultra turn them on
My Tracks: new My order sort, drag a track by its handle to put your tracks in any order
Your order is saved to your account, so it's the same on every device
New tracks show up at the top until you move them
Changelog shows when each update came out, in your own time zone
Cuppa: new Casual mode when hosting a cup, next to Competitive
Casual has no time limit, no points and no winner, just drive the track as long as you like
Join a casual cup at any time and you're on the track straight away
Vote for a new track from the cup menu: when over half the racers want one, the track changes
Tidier bottom bar on the home menu: it fits on one row again
Fullscreen, Music and Chat are icon buttons now (hover to see which is which)
Referrals, Credits and Race Control moved into a new More menu
Build Off: once you've sent your track you can watch the others build from the cup menu, with their camera and the block in their hand
Spectators can watch the builders too
Your own track stays safe while you watch and comes back when you stop
Organizers can change how the cup is won (points, rounds, knockout) and the number of rounds after it has started
Fixed everyone getting a DNF when the organizer's tab was in the background
Fixed the "e.hasFinished is not a function" error after a restart
Crates, Bolts and parts now save to your account, so they follow you to other devices
Difference at the bottom is back to the old timer
New Live difference setting shows your live gap to the ghost instead
Changelog button on the main menu, with a dot when there's something new
Big custom tracks get your car ready while the track loads, so the start isn't stuck
Difference at the bottom shows your live gap to the ghost while you drive
Update popup now shows what changed
Restarting on big Better Editor tracks doesn't freeze the car anymore
PolyFX colours, shading and sharpness redone
Graphics presets turn fog off
